text: {"name":"ble_scan_report_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Updates flags on the indexed scan entry, emits a four-byte report when the entry qualifies, and forwards a parameterless message to the supplied task pair.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v5":"scan_entry_index","v6":"scan_entries_base","v11":"entry_state","v15":"scan_entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":32,"meaning":"16-bit value copied into the first two bytes of the emitted report"},{"offset":34,"meaning":"byte copied into the fourth byte of the emitted report"},{"offset":53,"meaning":"flags byte with bits 0 and 2 updated according to the input mode and value"},{"offset":310,"meaning":"state byte that must equal 15 to emit a report in the nonzero input mode"}]}
